verdict.rationale: The first-party docs describe how to gate specific tool calls on human approval. Permission modes and rules decide what is auto-allowed, and the canUseTool callback handles everything else at runtime. It receives the tool name and input and pauses execution until the app returns a decision. The SDK surfaces approval requests (e.g. deleting files, running commands) to users and relays their decisions back, and hooks can block dangerous operations before they execute. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval flow in practice.
